messages:
Lina (Support): FYI incoming escalation from Acme — their rerank endpoint is returning 500s when the candidate snippets contain odd control chars / Latin-1 bytes. They noticed a big billing spike too when clients retry. Customer sent a small payload and logs.

Acme Integrations: hey, we started getting spurts of 500s around 09:12 UTC. Only when our crawler picks up pages with weird encodings. Example payload attached. Can you confirm? We're on a tight SLA. :sweat: 

Lina (Support): Thanks. Pasting the problematic snippet they sent (sanitized):

```
[
  {"id": "c1", "text": "Summary with normal text"},
  {"id": "c2", "text": "Price: \u00A35 \xC3\x28 broken-utf8"},
  {"id": "c3", "text": "Null byte here -> \u0000mid"},
  {"id": "c4", "text": "Emoji test \ud83d\ude0a"}
]
```

Lina (Support): Server error from our logs when they POST to /v1/rerank: 

```
ERROR Runtime: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xc3 in position 27: invalid continuation byte
  File "/app/runtime/serializer.py", line 142, in _decode
    text = body.decode('utf-8')
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/codecs.py", line 322, in decode
    return codecs.utf_8_decode(input, errors, True)
```

Tom H. (Eng-ML): Repro steps request — can we get raw bytes of the request? Lina, please ask Acme to send base64 of the request body (or a curl that uses printf).

Acme Integrations: Here's a quick curl we used that reproduces locally: 

```bash
printf '\\x50\\x72\\x69\\x63\\x65: \\xC2\\xA35 \\xC3\\x28' > payload.json
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' -d @payload.json
```

Rahul P. (Runtime): Thanks. Looks like a mix of Latin-1 and a truncated UTF-8 sequence (0xC3 followed by 0x28). Our request path is assuming valid UTF-8 and calling .decode('utf-8') without fallback. That will raise and bubble up as 500.

Tom H. (Eng-ML): Two things to consider: 1) return 400 if payload contains invalid UTF-8 (fail fast), 2) add a sanitization layer that replaces control chars / null bytes before model scoring (or strip candidates containing \u0000). Also add logging that records a hexdump of offending bytes (not PII).

Sarah L. (Support Lead): Customer is asking for ETA and wants billing credits for the retry storms. Can ops put a temporary billing hold or cap for Acme? @ops-bot any option to throttle their account while we fix? :pray: 

ops-bot: Noted. I can apply an emergency rate limit on acct_acme_123 for 1 hour. Confirm if you want strict 10r/s or block all writes.

Sarah L. (Support Lead): Start with 10r/s and let me know. We'll escalate billing credits afterwards.

Tom H. (Eng-ML): Quick patch idea for runtime: wrap the body decode in a try/except and return an informative 400 like: 

```python
try:
    payload_text = body.decode('utf-8')
except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
    logger.info("bad-encoding", extra={"hexdump": binascii.hexlify(body)})
    return Response(status=400, json={"error": "invalid-encoding", "detail": "request body not valid UTF-8"})
```

Rahul P. (Runtime): I'll open a hotfix PR to do exactly that + strip null bytes from candidates before sending to the model. Also will add an integration test that feeds many latin1 and truncated sequences.

Lina (Support): From support side can we provide the customer with a short workaround they can apply client-side?

Tom H. (Eng-ML): Yes — short term they should normalize incoming text to UTF-8 and remove control chars. Example node snippet: 

```js
// replace lone nulls and invalid sequences (best-effort)
function sanitize(s){
  return Buffer.from(s, 'binary').toString('utf8').replace(/\u0000/g, '');
}
```

Acme Integrations: Will try sanitize client-side and report back. ETA for your fix?

Rahul P. (Runtime): Hotfix PR opened, aiming for canary deploy in ~2 hours, full deploy after validation (~4 hours). I'll post the link when ready.

Sarah L. (Support Lead): Great. I'm starting the billing cap and pre-authorizing a credit for retry charges. Lina, send an interim note to the customer with the workaround, timeline, and that we applied rate limiting.

Lina (Support): Sending message now. Will keep thread updated with the PR + deploy logs. Thanks everyone. :v:
